meta.title: AlmondGold · Dr.99 Day-by-Day Run Sheet: Purple Kush Auto
meta.strain: Purple Kush Auto (Tastebudz, via North Atlantic Seed Co)
meta.source_guide: Dr.99 Complete Grow Guide to Purple Kush Auto
meta.day_1_definition: Day 1 = seed goes into its RO soak; Week n = Days 7n-6 to 7n
rules: If light stress shows, stay on yesterday's PPFD one more day.
If first pistils show earlier/later than Day 24, start the +25/day flower ramp that day and slide the PPFD numbers that follow.

days.reservoir_task: Fill 5.5 gal plain RO; air stone + chiller on (66–68°F)
days.actions: Soak seed in a cup of RO, dark, 75–80°F, 12–24 h. Hang yellow sticky trap. GGS: 18/6, alarms on.

days.reservoir_task: Plain RO; pre-soak plug in pH 5.8 RO
days.actions: Taproot 1/4–1/2″? Plant it taproot-down 1/4–1/2″ deep in a damp (not dripping) Rapid Rooter. Not cracked: damp paper towel, check every 12 h.

days.reservoir_task: CHANGE → Wk 1 mix (ml per 5.5 gal RO): Armor Si 1.5 → CaliMagic 3 → Micro 4 → Gro 4 → Bloom 1.5 → RapidStart 5.5 → Hydroguard 11 → pH 5.8
days.actions: Plug into net pot, clay pebbles level with plug top. Water touches pot bottom, 1/4–1/2″ up. Light at PPFD 150 at plug top. 75–80°F, RH 65–75%.
days.watch_for: Sprout breaks the plug in 1–3 days

days.reservoir_task: Top off to line with pH 5.8 RO, then read pH + EC
days.actions: Hands off. Lift the net pot to feel weight; plug should stay damp from wicking.

days.reservoir_task: Top off to line with pH 5.8 RO, then read pH + EC
days.actions: Daily check (water temp, bubbles, pH, EC, log).
days.watch_for: Long wobbly stem = light too far; pale/cupped = too much

days.reservoir_task: Top off to line with pH 5.8 RO, then read pH + EC
days.actions: PPFD +20 → 170. Daily check.

days.reservoir_task: Top off to line with pH 5.8 RO, then read pH + EC
days.actions: PPFD 190. Peek at roots through the lid.
days.watch_for: Roots 1–2″ below pot → drop water to 1″ below pot bottom

days.reservoir_task: CHANGE → Wk 2 mix (ml per 5.5 gal RO): Armor Si 3 → CaliMagic 5.5 → Micro 8 → Gro 8 → Bloom 3 → RapidStart 5.5 → Hydroguard 11 → pH 5.8
days.actions: Week 2 res change (keep this weekday from now on). Calibrate pH 7 + 4. PPFD 210. RH 55–70%, VPD 0.8–1.2.

days.actions: PPFD 230. Keep lowering the water as roots grow.

Wk 2 mix (ml per 5.5 gal RO): Armor Si 3 → CaliMagic 5.5 → Micro 8 → Gro 8 → Bloom 3 → RapidStart 5.5 → Hydroguard 11 → pH 5.8

Wk 5 mix (ml per 5.5 gal RO): Armor Si 5.5 → CaliMagic 8 → Micro 16.5 → Gro 8 → Bloom 19 → Hydroguard 11 → pH 5.8

mixing_order.title: Drain, wipe, refill 5.5 gal RO
mixing_order.detail: Check root color and smell while the bucket is open. Calibrate the pH pen (7 + 4).

mixing_order.title: Armor Si first
mixing_order.detail: Stir 1 min, wait ~5 min before anything else.

mixing_order.title: CaliMagic → Micro → Gro → Bloom
mixing_order.detail: Stir between each one. Micro always goes before Bloom.

mixing_order.title: Wait 5–10 min → pH 5.8 → read EC
mixing_order.detail: The EC should land inside that week's range.

daily_check_routine.title: Water + air
daily_check_routine.detail: Water 67–68°F, strong bubbles, no leaks. Check the GGS graph.

daily_check_routine.title: Top off first
daily_check_routine.detail: Fill to the marked line with plain RO at pH ~5.8, then take readings. If EC is falling fast in heavy flower, top off with a quarter-strength mix instead.

daily_check_routine.title: pH
daily_check_routine.detail: Target 5.8; leave it alone from 5.6 to 6.0. Outside that, add 0.5 ml pH Down diluted in a cup of res water, stir, wait 15 min, and re-read. A slow rise is normal. A fast drop means check the roots.

daily_check_routine.title: EC vs yesterday
daily_check_routine.detail: Falling means she's hungry, so mix at the high end next week. Rising means it's too strong, so top off with plain RO. Flat is perfect.

daily_check_routine.title: Light
daily_check_routine.detail: Set today's PPFD, and re-measure at the tallest top every 2–3 days. Taco or bleach means repeat yesterday's number.

daily_check_routine.title: Look + log
daily_check_routine.detail: Check new growth, leaf undersides, and the sticky trap. From Week 7, check inside the big colas for rot. Write it all in the Log view.

stage_targets.why_title: Water and warmth wake the seed
stage_targets.why: The dark soak mimics soil. Planting taproot-down means the root never has to turn around.

stage_targets.why_title: Low light, humid air, half-strength food
stage_targets.why: Tiny roots can't move much water yet. Hydroguard from the first mix gets good bacteria on the roots before pythium can.

stage_targets.why_title: Build the roots and the frame
stage_targets.why: A slow +20/day ramp lets leaves adapt without bleaching. An auto can't extend veg, so plant size is mostly set now. LST opens the canopy.
Bloom goes up because flowers need more P and K. Finish LST so the stretch builds a flat table of tops.
She can grow 1.5–2× taller. Light is the engine here. CO2 only helps once PPFD is already high.
KoolBloom covers peak P/K demand. 40–50% RH keeps dense colas safe from rot. Cool nights from Day 50 bring out the purple.
EC drops and the plant uses its stores. Trichomes, not pistils, tell you when she's ready.
RO + FloraKleen for the last 7–10 days. The dry and cure change the smoke more than the flush does.

harvest_dry_cure.do: IPA-clean scissors, gloves. Fan leaves off wet, hang branches spaced. Weigh wet. Clean the system.

harvest_dry_cure.conditions: Dark tent, ~60°F / ~60% RH (58–62°F, 55–62%), exhaust low through carbon
harvest_dry_cure.do: Daily squeeze + mold check. Gentle indirect air, never a fan on the buds.
Snap test small stems daily from dry day 7.
Small stems snap → final dry trim + buck, save trim for rosin. Weigh dry (~20–25% of wet). Jars 3/4 full, packed loose.
harvest_dry_cure.watch_for: Buds damp after a few hours in the jar → lids off 1–2 h
Ammonia smell = too wet, dry longer

harvest_dry_cure.do: Add a 62% Boveda per jar, burp weekly. Smokable from here.
Flavor keeps improving up to 4–8 weeks.
